	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				culture = { has_cultural_parameter = rice_cultivators_next_level_paddy_fields }
			}
			building_farmed_high_medieval_trigger = yes
			holding_district_level_3_trigger = yes
		}
		trigger_else = {
			building_farmed_late_medieval_trigger = yes
			holding_district_level_4_trigger = yes
		}

	construction_time = construction_time_1_year
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 5
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_3_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = rice_confectionary_income_tier_3
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = rice_confectionary_income_tier_3_tribal
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_rice
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 3
		modifiers = {
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = rice_confectionary_artisan_tax_per_rice_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = rice_confectionary_artisan_tax_per_rice_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = rice_confectionary_4
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_rice CATEGORY = trade_category_cereals }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 3 }
	}

}
